description: In a nonempty directed preorder, the upper tails \(\{x:a\le x\}\), indexed by points \(a\), form a base for the filter of sets containing an upper tail. On \(\mathbb N\), this is the cofinite filter.
signature:
Filter.atTop_basis.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [Nonempty α] :
  Filter.atTop.HasBasis (fun x => True) Set.Ici
